description: Pre-built webhook payload templates for Slack (Block Kit), Discord (embeds), and Microsoft Teams (Adaptive Cards). Adds a webhookFormat option to the notify config that transforms the NotifyEvent into platform-native rich message payloads instead of raw JSON. Each template produces visually rich, actionable messages with color-coded status, workflow name, cost, and a clickable deep link.
steps: In src/workflow/notify.ts, add a new type WebhookFormat = 'raw' | 'slack' | 'discord' | 'teams' and add webhookFormat?: WebhookFormat to the NotifyConfig interface.

Create src/workflow/webhook-templates.ts with three formatter functions: formatSlackPayload(event: NotifyEvent): object - produces Slack Block Kit JSON with: header block (workflow name + status emoji), section block (detail text), context block (cost, timestamp), and an actions block with a deep-link button when url is present. Use color-coded attachment sidebar (green=completed, red=failed, orange=budget, yellow=approval/input). formatDiscordPayload(event: NotifyEvent): object - produces Discord webhook embed with: title, description, color (decimal int for status), fields array (Cost, Workflow, Run ID), timestamp, and a URL field for the deep link. formatTeamsPayload(event: NotifyEvent): object - produces Microsoft Teams Adaptive Card with: TextBlock header, FactSet (workflow, status, cost), and an Action.OpenUrl pointing to the deep link when available.

Update the webhook() function in src/workflow/notify.ts to use the format: if webhookFormat is 'slack', 'discord', or 'teams', call the appropriate formatter and POST that instead of the raw NotifyEvent. 'raw' (or undefined) keeps the current behavior.
Update the notify schema in src/config/types.ts: add webhookFormat to the zod schema as z.enum(['raw', 'slack', 'discord', 'teams']).optional().

Write comprehensive tests in tests/webhook-templates.test.ts covering each format: verify Slack payload has blocks array with expected structure, Discord has embeds array with color codes matching event kinds, Teams has body with correct type AdaptiveCard. Test each event kind (run-completed, run-failed, budget-exceeded, approval-pending, input-pending) produces appropriate emoji/color/text. Test that when url is present, action buttons/links are included; when absent, they are omitted gracefully.
Write integration tests in the existing tests/notify.test.ts confirming that createNotifier with webhookFormat='slack' posts the transformed payload (not raw NotifyEvent) to the webhook URL.
acceptance_criteria: notify.webhookFormat: 'slack' produces valid Slack Block Kit JSON that renders in Slack's Block Kit Builder
notify.webhookFormat: 'discord' produces a valid Discord webhook embed payload with proper color integers
notify.webhookFormat: 'teams' produces a valid Microsoft Teams Adaptive Card
Each template maps all 5 event kinds to distinct visual treatments (emoji, color, heading text)
Deep links appear as clickable buttons/links when the url field is present in the event
The 'raw' format (and omitted format) preserves exact current behavior - no breaking change
Config schema validates webhookFormat and rejects unknown format strings
All new and existing tests pass, typecheck passes, lint passes
findings: All verification passed on first attempt. 2146 tests pass (48 new tests added). No lint or typecheck issues. Build produces correct output. The feature is purely additive with no breaking changes to existing behavior.
